Adapted fragments: section 2's multi-product request and section 4's
"Multi-item parsing" examples (separate products, per-product quantities,
ambiguous scope) in shopping_agent/skills/altas.md; section 4's "Fuzzy matching"
whole-milk/oat-milk clarification in shopping_agent/skills/cambios.md.
Examples are translated and changed to our package quantities and tool names.

All procedures are application-specific: drafts rather than immediate writes,
strict integer quantities, explicit confirmation, no automatic merge/archive,
and no original command implementation, identity switching or file operations.
Only these examples are adapted; the original skill is not loaded or executed.
